Yes. The current evidence (version 2, knowledge as of 2026-11-12) shows that all four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-08. No thermal detections intersected the property in that period.

An earlier version (version 1, dated 2026-10-08) had gaps on 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-08, because the near-real-time data had not yet been published. That version is superseded, and the gap has since been filled.

Complete coverage doesn't prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires may go undetected. The result also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change, or anything outside this period.
